deliverable_rules.triage: Unique records by id, keep first. Sort urgent first then id ascending within each group. Preserve all four fields exactly.
deliverable_rules.metrics: Object with unique_count, total_hours, urgent_hours, team_hours (object A/B). Use unique records only.
deliverable_rules.allocation: With capacity 10 hours, scan triage in order; accept a record if its hours fit remaining capacity, otherwise defer it and continue scanning. Object selected_ids (ordered), deferred_ids (ordered), used_hours, remaining_hours.
deliverable_rules.risks: Object overloaded (total unique hours > 10), deferred_ids (from allocation), missing_owners (true if no named people in source; teams are not named people).
deliverable_rules.brief: Object capacity_hours=10, overload_hours=max(total unique hours-10,0), requires_approval=true, sent=false, recommendation="request_more_capacity" if overloaded else "within_capacity".

stop_rule: Stop on prerequisite, quota, timeout or malformed usage; preserve output failures without retries. Mark remaining planned slots NOT_RUN.
comparison_status: NOT_VERIFIED as clean skill A/B: shared configured host/global skills and ancestor instructions are not isolated.

arms.workflow: All deliverables in one call with exact explicit loop-work text appended.
arms.plain: All deliverables in one call without explicit workflow append; not a no-skill host.
arms.manual: One call per deliverable, full prior prompt/answer history replayed in separate ephemeral calls.

metrics: Sum actual input+output (cached input already included); uncached=input-cached; wall includes CLI lifecycle; no dollar estimate.
aggregation: Per case/arm mean of two completed packages. Reduction=100*(1-workflow/baseline). Overall primary pooled ratio of sums across the equally repeated case mix; also show equal-case mean reduction. No confidence interval, independence, or causal skill attribution claimed.
quality_rule: Exact typed JSON equality for every stage and final merged artifact, no tools, one valid usage event and zero exit. Consistency means both repetitions PASS, not pass@k.
